assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The Holter monitor is medically necessary to evaluate for arrhythmias
The Holter monitor is used to assess the hemodynamic impact of the valvular pathology
The service is documented in the clinical indication note
The service directly addresses the patient's symptoms and the underlying cardiac conditions for which it was ordered
